dataset.name: Desert Island Disks (Finnegan, Rangel Smith & Van Stroud, 2021), built on Gustar (2020) and Morgan (2018)

method.intake: Birth year, place of birth and 3 of the person's own chosen artists. Names withheld from every system.
method.hidden: The person's other chosen artists that resolve exactly in Qloo (1–4 per person).
method.metric: A hit is a hidden artist in the system's top 20. Hit rate = share of people with at least one hit; recall = share of hidden artists found.
method.youth: Share of dated picks whose career started by the end of the person's youth (+2 years), using Qloo's start_year. Not available for the plain model, which gives no evidence.
method.overlap: Average list overlap between people (Jaccard). Lower means more personal lists.
